def VTask.greatestOfBdd {P : ℤ → Prop} [DecidablePred P] (b : ℤ) 
    (Hb : ∀ z, P z → z ≤ b) (Hinh : ∃ z, P z) : 
    { ub | P ub ∧ ∀ z, P z → z ≤ ub } :=
  let ⟨z, hz⟩ := Hinh
  let h_exists_b : ∃ z ≤ b, P z := ⟨z, Hb z hz, hz⟩
  let ⟨ub, h_p_ub⟩ :=
    let rec findMax (c : ℤ) (h_exists : ∃ z ≤ c, P z) : { ub | P ub } :=
      if h_p_c : P c then
        ⟨c, h_p_c⟩
      else
        have h_exists' : ∃ z ≤ c - 1, P z :=
          let ⟨z, hz_le_c, hz⟩ := h_exists
          if hz_eq_c : z = c then
            absurd hz (by rw [hz_eq_c]; exact h_p_c)
          else
            let hz_lt_c : z < c := lt_of_le_of_ne hz_le_c (ne_of_eq_not hz_eq_c)
            ⟨z, le_of_lt hz_lt_c, hz⟩
        let ⟨ub', h_p_ub'⟩ := findMax (c - 1) h_exists'
        ⟨ub', h_p_ub'⟩
    findMax b h_exists_b
  have h_max : ∀ z, P z → z ≤ ub :=
    assume z hz_p,
    let hz_le_b := Hb z hz_p in
    by_contradiction
      assume hz_gt_ub : z > ub,
      let hz_in_range : ub < z ∧ z ≤ b := by linarith [hz_gt_ub, hz_le_b] in
      absurd (lt_irrefl ub (lt_of_lt_of_eq (lt_of_gt hz_gt_ub) rfl)) trivial
  ⟨ub, h_p_ub, h_max⟩
